scope: Eight historical main cases R7M-09-A through R7M-12-B and their four associated branches read as text only. Fresh source/arithmetic review for reconstruction; no acceptance or runtime execution.

sourceCards.mass-charm:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, up to six creatures, one minute and WIS ending saves. NEW declare one to six distinct creatures personally perceived within range and caster line of effect before commitment. There is no Humanoid-only gate, hearing requirement, shared-language requirement or bonus for already-friendly targets. Hidden immunity is resolved after a legal cast pays. At resolution each still-legal selected creature makes its own initial WIS save; success establishes nothing. A failed save attempts only Core Charmed toward this caster, subject to the actual applicable defenses. Lost or immune selections are not replaced after results.

NEW no concentration. Each admitted relation lasts for at most 60 elapsed seconds from resolution. The target repeats WIS at each actual regular END, including an affected current turn's END, and after the first positive post-defense/pre-temporary-HP damage event each numbered round caused by the caster or a genuine ally of that caster. Full prevention leaving zero damage supplies no harm save; temporary HP or an HP floor can prevent normal HP loss without preventing that positive-damage save. Use actual causal attribution and relationships at the event, not a false label declared to evade the trigger. A multi-component hit remains its one real event. A successful repeat save ends only this cast's relation on that recipient; others keep their own histories and clocks. Outside initiative the shared END-only cadence applies. If multiple Mass Charm records from the same caster could otherwise offer damage saves to one recipient, their family-level first-harm-event ledger prevents a recast from inventing another opportunity in the same numbered round.

The actual Charmed condition prevents knowingly willing harm to the charmer and gives that charmer advantage on social ability checks against the target. It does not compel affection, obedience, testimony, surrender, a changed belief, protection of the charmer, an attack, a binding agreement or a permanent faction-standing adjustment. Unlike Charm Person's additional source wording, this source supplies no separate friendly-attitude rewrite. Actual involuntary behavior from another source does not become voluntary solely because a charm relation exists. Multiple charmers retain independent relations; advantage does not accumulate. No hard-control allowance is spent for this relation alone.

NEW a genuinely established later Mass Charm relation replaces that caster's older Mass Charm relation on that same target, not another charmer's or another named spell's relation. A saved-against or immune new attempt does not replace an old one. Suppression suspends the harm prohibition/social advantage while the original deadline and saves continue; it does not create consent or erase the target's memory. Actual condition cure, eligible source removal or target death ends the relation. Caster death alone does not reset or extend this nonconcentration deadline: the relation remains tied to that same identity for the short remaining interval, with only consequences that can actually apply. Resurrection of that identity creates no fresh minute. Expiry or ending causes no automatic accusation, amnesia or punishment; characters may draw ordinary conclusions from witnessed events.
sourceCards.greater-invisibility: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. Choose one willing creature you perceive with line of effect, including yourself. KEEP the target stays Invisible while attacking. NEW replace the contradictory Instantaneous metadata with concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds. Unlike the reviewed ordinary Invisibility identity, no Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, attack, dealt damage, forced save, spellcasting or other technique ends this effect merely by being used. Actual loss of this spell’s concentration, expiry, qualifying removal or the recipient’s actual death ends it. A different concentration spell cast by its own caster still displaces it normally. The recipient’s actual initial worn/held/carried noncreature gear within its lawful anatomy and capacity shares visual concealment while that same item remains in its possession. Dropped, fired or transferred items immediately become visible; regripping one later does not restore this cast’s concealment, and newly picked-up external property never gains it. No carried creature, mount or independently living body is concealed by that gear clause. Existing melded property retains its real body/equipment history without creating a second visible item. Ordinary voice, footfalls, tracks, light emitted by actual equipment and physical interaction remain real. A revealing attack can leave the creature Invisible while observers learn its location and lose only the Invisible-specific attack modifiers. Neither location knowledge nor Investigation grants sight through this actual condition; use an actual qualifying sense/removal. Suppression suspends this record’s concealment while its original deadline runs; it neither deletes observer knowledge nor restores a spent/released item to the initial gear set. Multiple owners’ sources retain separate concentration records, with no stacked Invisible benefit. There is no continuing caster-to-target range tether after application.
sourceCards.mind-maze: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes WIS. Success establishes nothing. KEEP failure loses one round in confusion. NEW on a failed save, if actual defenses permit and the shared hard-control allowance is unused, establish a custom lost-round state immediately until the end of the target’s next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn. There is no concentration; this ongoing rank-4 rider expressly survives the original Instantaneous metadata and is subject to qualifying removal/suppression. It prohibits new full Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and voluntary movement commitments. Already legally committed Actions/Reactions finish their actual resolution; movement already spent is not refunded, while later uncommitted movement cannot begin. Extra turns inside the interval gain no exception and do not shorten the endpoint. The target still makes actual required saves, death saves and ending checks, can perceive/think and use permitted speech, retains passive defenses and can be moved by independent forces. This is not Stunned, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Blinded or the ordinary Confusion spell; it imposes no automatic failed saves, attack advantage, forced hostile attack or concentration loss by itself. Ordinary damage or a separately applicable incapacitating state still affects concentration normally. Apply the shared future attached-phase/six-second bridge where the recipient has no regular turn, without inventing a companion turn. Consume the source-character/target/encounter guard only on establishment; an already spent guard or relevant immunity blocks this entire lost-round state, with no replacement penalty. Charmed-only immunity does not cover a rider that imposes no Charmed condition; actual broader defenses apply. Suppression permits whatever normal actions are otherwise legal while suppressed, without restoring budgets already spent or extending the endpoint. The used hard-control allowance remains used after early removal or suppression. No repeat save is added; expiry/removal/death of the recipient ends the rider. No teleportation or stopped personal time occurs.

slow.targets: Actual Enchantment mode: choose up to six creatures you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. Actual Transmutation mode: the triggering creature must be perceived within 60 feet and line of effect and must be selected; choose up to five additional such creatures. The actual casting class determines school/mode; paying the same rank-3/base-5-RP price never grants the other package.
slow.duration: Both modes: concentration, up to one minute. In initiative, the maximum ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; no timing-mode change resets it.
slow.resolution: Enchantment uses an Action and an independent Wisdom save per target. Transmutation uses a Reaction when a creature you perceive within 60 feet/line of effect begins a distinct voluntary movement segment or begins an Action on its own actual turn, after required declaration/commitment and before the segment’s first step or Action’s first main outcome. An extra turn can trigger; Bonus Actions and Reactions cannot. Transmutation gives each chosen target an independent Constitution save. Success: no new effect for that target. Failure: apply only that actual mode’s independently defended rider set. Each affected creature repeats that mode’s recorded WIS or CON save at every affected regular-turn END, including the current regular turn if applied during it; success ends that cast’s application on that creature. Extra turns grant no ending saves. Outside initiative an otherwise legally established ongoing effect uses the specifically bound six-second END-save cadence, never a new Reaction trigger.
slow.effect: Enchantment failure: half Speed under existing strongest-adverse-Speed arbitration; -2 AC; -2 Dexterity ability checks and Dexterity saving throws, expressly excluding initiative; and at most one full Action commitment per actual turn. It changes no DEX score/modifier, DEX attack/damage, spell DC or other unnamed derived statistic. AC has only its separate -2. Count an Action already committed before application toward the ceiling; an already-legally-committed second Action still finishes, but no further Action can be committed that turn. The ceiling applies independently on extra turns; it retains Bonus Actions, Reactions and inherent attacks in a legal Attack Action. Transmutation failure: half Speed, -2 AC and no future Reaction commitments. It imposes no DEX penalty or Action ceiling. Already-committed unresolved Reactions remain on the LIFO stack. Neither mode grants unprinted spell delay, attack-count restriction, Action/Bonus-Action interchange, cancellation or teleport restriction.
slow.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
slow.limitations: Transmutation’s movement trigger is one distinct segment, such as moving, performing an Action, then resuming movement; choosing another square during continuous movement is not a new segment, and individual feet/tiles are never new triggers. A paid Slow remains independent if a legal nested interruption removes the original parent Action: resolve it against still-legal selected targets, without refund, revival or parent cancellation. A surviving parent Action continues after the interrupt stack; movement recalculates remaining legal allowance before the next expenditure, keeping all movement already spent. The one-Action ceiling, Reaction denial and other soft riders do not claim whole-Action hard-control allowance. Actual narrowly scoped defenses can suppress individual components. Each cast/mode retains separate caster, concentration, saves and deadline. Half-Speed records compete against the same pre-control Speed, then existing later systemic multipliers apply. Identical Slow -2 AC and DEX penalties do not add; independent Enchantment and Transmutation casts may supply their distinct surviving riders together. Enchantment access: Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard, Paladin. Transmutation access: Dragoon, Druid, Mage, Monk, Ranger, Shaman, Tinker. Preserve each exact minimum class level. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.
slow.designNotes: PRESERVED: both school/rank-3 modes, 60 feet, V/S/F, up to six targets; Enchantment Action/half Speed/-2 AC/-2 DEX/one action, and Transmutation Reaction/half Speed/-2 AC/no Reactions. NEW: WIS versus CON, concentration minute/repeat END saves, explicit distinct-segment/Action Reaction window with mandatory triggering target, scoped DEX exception and full-Action ceiling. No mode union from a single cast; independent overlaps keep provenance.
